item.title: Saipan Chamber’s Economic Forum set for March 11
item.description: (SCC) — The Saipan Chamber of Commerce will hold its 4th Annual Economic Forum on Wednesday, March 11, 2026, at Kensington Hall at the Kensington Hotel Saipan. It will run from 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. ChST, with doors opening at 7:30 a.m., formal sessions beginning at 8:15 a.m., concluding at 5 p.m., and followed by a networking mixer from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. The post Saipan Chamber’s Economic Forum set for March 11 appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Saipan mayor appoints Paulette Tomokane, reappoints Guadalupe Attao to SHEFA board
item.description: SAIPAN Mayor Ramon Blas “RB” Camacho appointed Public School System Student Supports Services School Counselor Program Manager Paulette Tomokane, Ed.D., to the Saipan Higher Education Financial Assistance Board of Directors Monday. He also reappointed current member Guadalupe T. Attao to the board. The post Saipan mayor appoints Paulette Tomokane, reappoints Guadalupe Attao to SHEFA board appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: CNMI receives $2M in opioid settlement funds
item.description: THE CNMI has received $2 million in opioid settlement proceeds, the Opioid Proceeds Council or OPC reported to Gov. David M. Apatang. The post CNMI receives $2M in opioid settlement funds appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: King-Hinds seeks governor and community input on draft CNMI labor stabilization legislation
item.description: WASHINGTON D.C. (Office of the CNMI Congressional Delegate) — Delegate Kimberlyn King-Hinds has shared a draft proposal to amend the Commonwealth’s immigration transition framework and is inviting review and feedback from Gov. David M. Apatang and leaders across the CNMI before formally introducing the legislation in the U.S. Congress. The post King-Hinds seeks governor and community input on draft CNMI labor stabilization legislation appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Camacho nominated as trial court presiding judge
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang has nominated Associate Judge Joseph Norita Camacho to serve as the next presiding judge of the CNMI Superior Court, formally submitting the appointment to the Senate for advice and consent. The post Camacho nominated as trial court presiding judge appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Power outage, water service disruptions hit Saipan
item.description: SAIPAN experienced an islandwide power outage Friday around 1:45 p.m., leaving residents and businesses without electricity for several hours. Power was fully restored across the island by 6 p.m., according to the Commonwealth Utilities Corporation. The post Power outage, water service disruptions hit Saipan appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
